title: ～極まる (〜kiwamaru)
shortExplanation: Also expresses an extreme degree or state, typically negative.
longExplanation: The ～極まる form often appears with な-adjectives: e.g., 失礼極まる, 非常識極まる ('extremely rude/unreasonable'). It's largely synonymous with ～極まりない but tends to appear in set phrases. Both forms are quite formal and emphatic.
formation: な-Adjective（語幹）+ 極まる, い-Adjective（連用形）+ こと + 極まる, etc.

examples.jp: 彼の言動は失礼極まる。
examples.romaji: Kare no gendou wa shitsurei kiwamaru.
examples.en: His words and actions are extremely rude.

examples.jp: その態度は非常識極まる。
彼女の発言は無責任極まる。
examples.romaji: Kanojo no hatsugen wa musekinin kiwamaru.

examples.jp: このような誤解は遺憾極まる。
examples.romaji: Kono youna gokai wa ikan kiwamaru.
examples.en: Such a misunderstanding is exceedingly regrettable.
